cite.quote: The Allied invasion of German-occupied France commenced on 6 June 1944.

summary.text: The easternmost of the D-Day landing beaches, from Ouistreham to Saint-Aubin-sur-Mer. It was assaulted by the British 3rd Infantry Division of I Corps, with attached units including the 1st Special Service Brigade and its Free French commandos. The division's main objective was Caen, and it was to relieve the 6th Airborne Division at the bridges over the Orne and the Caen Canal. The advance on Caen was halted by a counter-attack of the 21st Panzer Division.
